theorems.name: Submission.frt_graph_piece_density_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (A Γ : Set (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ), μHE[n] A ≠ ∞ → NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → 0 ≤ L → IsClosed Γ → (∀ y ∈ Γ, ∀ z ∈ Γ, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A).restrict Γ, (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2)) ^ n)⁻¹ ≤ liminf (densityRatio n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x) (𝓝[>] 0) ∧ limsup (densityRatio n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2)) ^ n
